title: Agentflow test plan frontmatter
description: Contract for the YAML frontmatter of a test plan at docs/features/<批次>/testing/<project>-<feature-slug>/plan-<YYYY-MM-DD>-<NNN>.md — the case catalog a test executor runs against one feature. The directory is anchored on the tested feature, not the date. The plan is revised in place (bump test_version); run records pin the version they executed. Credentials are declared as an injection method, never as values.

project.description: Slug of the repository or project under test (e.g. aiwork).

feature.description: Feature or scope identifier in the target project.

target_revision.description: Commit of the target repository the cases were written against — later edits there must not retroactively change what the cases mean.

credentials.description: How credentials reach the executor (e.g. 'session-injected env, never persisted'). Values are forbidden here and anywhere in the body.

base_url.description: Environment under test (e.g. the staging origin). Never carries credentials.

case_count.description: Number of cases in the 用例 registry table; the checker asserts equality. Frontmatter values are strings by contract.

test_version.description: Bumped on every revision; run records pin the version they executed.

superseded_by.description: test_plan_id of the plan that supersedes this one.
